root_idea.summary: The clearest semantic center is وَبَر, the fur or soft hair of animals. The root also contains distinct lexical branches for the hyrax, fur-associated names and idioms, and several derived constructions.
root_idea.development: The sources explicitly present these as discrete, not wholly predictable lexical items: the fur/material term extends to animal and social expressions, while other branches concern truffles, residence, persistence, pollination, and named places.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular/collective citation form وَبَر; the Quran attests its plural أَوْبَار.

senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural أَوْبَار and occurs in an expression listing animal materials, referring to their fur or soft hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hyrax, a small desert mammal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for the animal; its plural forms include وِبَار and وُبُور.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of the seven late-winter days known as أَيَّامُ العَجُوز.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as the name of a day, with or without the definite article according to the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People of tents, or desert-dwellers, contrasted with settled town and city people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression refers to people associated with tents made from animal hair or fur.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a thing in its entirety; to take the whole of it.
To have, or be characterized by, abundant fur; furry or thick-furred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: وَبِرَ is used of a camel, and the descriptive noun وَبِر is likewise applied to a camel and to similar animals such as a hare or rabbit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree was fecundated or pollinated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive construction used specifically of a palm tree; مَوْبُورَةٌ is an equivalent participial description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist in, or remain constantly engaged with, something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with عَلَى and referring to continued adherence or application to an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of small, downy, earth-coloured truffles or truffle-like growths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexicographical descriptions differ over whether they are strictly truffles; the designation concerns small growths associated with the breaking of the soil's crust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People who appear to have promise or merit but prove worthless.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative comparison used of persons who are thought to contain good but do not.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To experience disappointment, calamity, or misfortune from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiom describing an adverse experience caused by another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An evil, foul, or abominable calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression for a grievous adverse event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rabbit covered its trail with the fur on its foot tufts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a rabbit concealing its trace with fur.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain or stay in one's dwelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed usage describing remaining in place rather than departing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A land said to have belonged to the people of ʿĀd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a place-name or geographical designation.
Attested in the expression مَا بِالدَّارِ وَابِرٌ, meaning that there is no one in the house.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The verb's meaning is covered with the corresponding furry/abundant-fur branch.
Animal designation represented; the marrow statement is illustrative.
Fur or soft-hair meaning represented under the Quran-attested form.
Descriptive وَبِر usage is grouped with the corresponding وَبِرَ branch.
Literal truffle designation and both cited figurative idioms represented.
Equivalent participial form grouped with the palm-pollination construction.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence is the plural أَوْبَار, while the public headword is normalized to the supported singular/collective form وَبَر.
The identification of بَنَاتُ أَوْبَرَ varies in the cited lexicographical descriptions between a truffle species and similar small soil growths.
